name: Lada
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Lada is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Judah through the Shelah line. He was the son of Er and is counted among Judah's family lines. He is known mainly from the genealogies in the Books of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Lada is mentioned as the son of Er in the genealogy of Judah's descendants through the Shelah line.

keyEvents.title: Part of Shelah's Family Line
keyEvents.description: Lada belongs to the descendants of Shelah, Judah's third son, and is thus part of the broader tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Mareshah
keyEvents.description: Lada is linked to Mareshah, a city in Judah, and is regarded as the father (founder) of Mareshah according to the genealogy.

keyEvents.title: Genealogy of the Tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: The full context of Judah's genealogy in 1 Chronicles provides background for Israel's tribal structure after the return from exile.
